# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in KeepAwake. Please open an issue before proposing a large change, and describe the problem and the Windows versions you tested.

Contributions are made under the repository's Apache License 2.0. Only submit work you have the right to contribute; retain third-party notices and identify any new dependencies or assets and their licenses. Do not include secrets, personal logs, or machine-specific configuration.

Please keep the application usable offline, preserve the existing data and security boundaries, and add meaningful verification for behavioral changes. Run the relevant checks documented in `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`; tests that modify power settings or scheduled tasks belong in a disposable Windows VM.

The project name and visual identity are not licensed as trademarks by the Apache License. See `TRADEMARKS.md`.
